messages:
Ana: Drafting a one-pager called 'SecureServe' 1 quick field-ready brief focused on compliant inference + deploy choices. Sharing benchmark blurbs, webinar hook, and routing tags. Link to draft: https://redwood.internal/briefs/secureserve (internal).

Tom: Love the angle. Quick ask 1 can we lead with a single crisp benefit line for the one-pager? CISOs want compliance + predictable latency.

Riley: Suggest header: "Compliant, predictable LLM inference across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments." Then a single stat: "~35% lower inference unit cost vs standard host configs" (conservative).

Jules: Benchmarks note: runs were on Dedicated with model quantization + prefix cache. Avg token unit cost down ~35%, 95th-pct tail latency improved ~30% in our test matrix. I'll attach PNGs to the brief.

Ana: Good. For SLAs let's be explicit: "Dedicated: 99.9% uptime SLA; Private (VPC/on-prem): contractual SLA options; Hosted: regional redundancy + best-effort fallback." Keep it short.

Tom: For deployment taxonomy on the one-pager, can we show a tiny decision flow: hosted -> quick try, dedicated -> production throughput/SLA, private -> regulated workloads. One small diagram placeholder will help.

Riley: Routing: field asked for targeted inbound tags so sales-eng can filter by deployment interest and urgency. Proposed YAML for intake system:
```yaml
inbound:
  tags: ["enterprise","secure-inference","SecureServe","vpc","onprem","dedicated","SLA"]
  assign: sales-eng
  priority: high
  funnel: evaluation-request
  note: "include desired latency, compliance/regulatory notes, and sample workload"
```

Jules: Add a separate quick-filter tag 'eval-kit' for leads that want our hands-on evaluation. Also flag if they need an NDA for private deploys.

Ana: Webinar hook (short headline): "Predictable inference for regulated apps" Webinar blurb (long): "Join us for a 40-min deep dive: architecture patterns for secure serving, real-world benchmarks, and how to run a free evaluation with your workload. Live Q&A with product + field." Agenda bullets: 1) secure architecture patterns 2) benchmark walkthrough 3) evaluation kit demo + next steps.

Tom: Social post (short): "New brief: SecureServe 1 how teams cut inference costs and hit SLAs for regulated apps. Sign up for the webinar." Include link + short UTM.

Riley: For the one-pager CTA: "Request a SecureServe evaluation kit 1 we'll run 2 sample scenarios with your workload and share a tailored ops report." Routing to funnel 'evaluation-request' as above.

Jules: I'll polish the security TL;DR and add a footnote on fallback & model variant routing when Dedicated capacity is constrained.

ops-bot: Webinar slot confirmed: 2026-05-19 16:00 PT | request 4271.

Ana: Excellent. If there are no objections I'll publish the internal brief tomorrow morning and kick the routing into ops. Final owners: copy (Jules), benchmarks & PNGs (Riley), routing snippet + ops handoff (Tom), webinar comms (Ana). :white_check_mark:
